notes.claim: A moment is the turning effect of a force about a pivot, and its size is force times the perpendicular distance from the pivot.
For a body to be balanced the clockwise moments must equal the anticlockwise moments about the pivot.
The moments balance about any point, so one can pick a support as the pivot; that support's own force then has no moment and drops out.
